item.title: From Vision to Practice: Realizing Net-Zero Manufacturing Through Circular Economy and Smart Production
item.content:encoded:
Yasser Dessouky, San Jose State University

Masood Fathi, University of Skövde

Taha Arbaoui, INSA Lyon

Khaled Hadj-Hamou, INSA Lyon

Ming-Lang Tseng, Asia University

This special issue addresses the critical challenge of transitioning manufacturing to net-zero operations by integrating circular economy principles with smart production technologies. The issue seeks research on how organizations can move from sustainability commitments to practical implementation strategies that reduce emissions, minimize waste, and create climate-neutral industrial systems.

The collection welcomes original research, case studies, and reviews that demonstrate emerging technologies and system-wide transformation frameworks. Topics range from Industry 4.0 applications and AI-driven optimization to supply chain decarbonization, renewable energy integration, and the role of regulatory policies in driving sustainable manufacturing practices.

Appel publié par International Journal of Production Research. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Closed-loop supply chains and waste reduction initiatives for low-carbon and climate-resilient manufacturing
  • Industry 4.0-enabled smart operations for net-zero manufacturing transformation
  • Life-cycle assessment of sustainable manufacturing processes
  • AI-driven optimization for energy-efficient production
  • Big data analytics and decision support for carbon footprint reduction
  • Renewable energy integration into industrial production systems
  • Electrification of industrial processes for carbon neutrality
  • AI-powered energy forecasting and optimization in manufacturing
  • The impact of carbon pricing and regulatory policies on production systems
  • Economic incentives and financial mechanisms for green manufacturing
  • Cross-sectoral collaboration for achieving net-zero industry goals
  • Policy-driven roadmaps for industrial decarbonization
  • Multi-criteria decision-making for net-zero manufacturing strategy development
